workload: One year of 1-minute closes (525,600 bars) with a missing bar every 50,000 minutes, period 20.
notes: compute_indicator calls this for EMA, MACD, and Wilder RSI. The loop enumerates a pandas Series, so every bar is boxed. The same reset-on-gap recurrence over the NumPy buffer returns an equal Series; a local copy of that loop was 296 ms to 128 ms on this workload.

workload: One year of 1-minute portfolio snapshots (525,600 bars) with a two-month drawdown, in bar order.
notes: The vector engine stores one snapshot per bar. The function builds a sorted equity-curve list and then a second drawdown list. One pass from the snapshots into the result list matched the current pairs and took 110 ms instead of 162 ms on this workload.

workload: Replay provenance document for a 2,000-symbol daily universe, the shape validate_provenance accepts.
notes: provenance_id hashes this document through canonical_bytes. The encoder builds a tagged Python tree and then json.dumps it. Traced peak is 3.9 MiB for about 680 KiB of output bytes, which the record tests lock. A writer that emits those same bytes without the tree removes more than 1 MiB of peak.

workload: One leap year of 15-minute equity, drawdown, TWR equity, TWR drawdown, and rolling Sharpe on a single backtest run.
notes: The dashboard formats every point into a [value, date] list, then _downsample keeps 300 points. Traced peak is 26.3 MiB. Choosing the kept indexes first and formatting only those points returns the same run-data dict without the temporary string lists.
